chunks: Regarding a woman who sees yellowish discharge: if that is two days before menstruation, then it is part of menstruation; and if it is two days after menstruation, then it is not part of menstruation.

key_terms.اَلصُّفْرَةَ: yellowish discharge seen by a woman
key_terms.اَلْحَيْضِ: menstruation; the legal state of menses
key_terms.اَلْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.بَعْدَ: after; indicating later timing in relation to menstruation
key_terms.بِيَوْمَيْنِ: by two days; the specified time frame for the ruling
key_terms.قَبْلَ: before; indicating prior timing in relation to menstruation

ai.seo_question: When is yellowish discharge considered part of menstruation in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about yellowish discharge seen by a woman in relation to her menstrual cycle. It states that such discharge counts as hayd if it appears two days before menstruation, but it does not count as hayd if it appears two days after menstruation.
